I want to include a reactive markdown file (*.Md) in a mainPanel conditional on the input to a selectInput. How do I do it?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: reactive IncludeMarkdown
parts:
I don't know how good it's going to look, but this should work:

In your UI:

uiOutput("md_file")

In your server:

output$md_file <- renderUI({
  file <- switch(input$var1,
    option1 = "option1.Md",
    option2 = "option2.Md",
    option2 = "option3.Md",
    stop("Unknown option")
  )
  includeMarkdown(file)
})

Try installing the latest Shiny from GitHub (devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")), you should get much better error messages.

That particular error usually means you've put a stray comma in your ui.R or renderUI, like the one after uiOutput("ui") here:

tags$div(
  plotOutput("plot"),
  uiOutput("ui"),
)
